verdict.rationale: Vue ships official first-party libraries that developers build against: Vue Router, Pinia, @vue/test-utils, the server-renderer, and the @vue/runtime-core custom renderer API. That counts as an official package ecosystem, but none of it is framed as an SDK for AI-native or agentic use, and the OpenAPI probe found no service API surface. Missing for 10: SDK-style documentation positioned for AI-native workflows, multi-language SDK coverage, and independent corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Libraries: Vue Router, Pinia, Tooling Guide
We recommend using @vue/test-utils for testing components in applications.
